fullTextEN: Ah, I hate working the most!
Work is too tiring.

fullTextZH: 如果有人每个月给我钱，
fullTextEN: If someone gave me money every month,
How great would that be!

fullTextZH: 嗯？做什么可以赚很多钱呢？
fullTextEN: Hmm? What can I do to earn a lot of money?
If sleeping could make money,
How great would that be!
Or should I sell air?

fullTextZH: 嗯，台湾人最喜欢国外的东西了。
fullTextEN: Hmm, Taiwanese people love foreign things the most.
I can sell British air,
10 dollars a bag.
Hmm, ah!
I got it!

fullTextZH: 我知道有一个方法可以赚很多钱！
fullTextEN: I know a way to make a lot of money!
Hello, I'm Xika,
I am Taiwanese.

fullTextZH: 你好吗？欢迎回来Lazy Chinese听故事！
fullTextEN: How are you? Welcome back to Lazy Chinese to listen to stories!

fullTextZH: 上次我们说了一个小气的人的故事，
fullTextEN: Last time we talked about the story of a stingy person,

fullTextZH: 今天我们要说懒惰的人的故事。
fullTextEN: Today we will talk about the story of a lazy person.
Laziness is not wanting to do things,
Just want to play or sleep.

fullTextZH: 有一个人，他非常非常懒惰。
fullTextEN: There is a person who is very, very lazy.
He hates working.
Every day he thinks, ah,

fullTextZH: 做什么可以赚很多钱呢？
fullTextEN: What can make a lot of money?
He only wants to do a little bit,
and then make a lot of money.
Hmm? What is so good?
Do you want it?
One day,
The lazy person thought of it!
He thought of a method,
As long as he does a little bit,
he can make a lot of money.

fullTextZH: 他听说，在很远很远的地方，
fullTextEN: He heard that in a very far place,

fullTextZH: 有一种特别的人是独眼人。
fullTextEN: there is a special kind of person called one-eyed people.

fullTextZH: 独眼人就是他们只有一只眼睛。
fullTextEN: One-eyed people are those who have only one eye.

fullTextZH: 他想，我要去抓一只独眼人，
fullTextEN: He thought, I want to catch a one-eyed person,

fullTextZH: 然后让大家看只有一只眼睛的人，
fullTextEN: and then let everyone see a person with only one eye,
charging 100 yuan per view.
Lazy people are very happy,
He thinks he is really smart.
This method is great!
The next day, he went out.
He wants to find the one-eyed person.
He took a car, took a boat,
walked.

fullTextZH: 他旅行到很远很远的地方。
fullTextEN: He traveled to a very far place.

fullTextZH: 有一天，他看到路上有一个人，
fullTextEN: One day, he saw a person on the road,
Hmm, ah!
He has only one eye!
Wow! He found the one-eyed person!
Hmm!

fullTextZH: 现在他要想办法抓住独眼人。
fullTextEN: Now he wants to find a way to catch the one-eyed person.

fullTextZH: 他走过去和独眼人说话。
fullTextEN: He walked over to talk to the one-eyed person.
He said,
Hello, nice to meet you!

fullTextZH: 我家在很远很远的地方，
fullTextEN: My home is in a very far place,

fullTextZH: 有很多好玩好吃的东西。
fullTextEN: there are many fun and delicious things.

fullTextZH: 我很想请你来我家玩，好吗？
fullTextEN: I really want to invite you to my home to play, okay?

fullTextZH: 独眼人听了很高兴，他说，
fullTextEN: The one-eyed person was very happy to hear that, he said,
Wow! Thank you!
I really want to go!
Great! Awesome!
Let's go now!
Wait a moment, before we go,
I want to invite you to my home for a meal,
to meet my family,

fullTextZH: 我也跟我的家人说再见。
fullTextEN: and say goodbye to my family.
The lazy person was very happy,

fullTextZH: 因为独眼人真的想跟他回家。
fullTextEN: because the one-eyed person really wanted to go home with him.
So he said: Okay,
Let's go to your home first,
then to my home.

fullTextZH: 独眼人带懒惰的人回到家。
fullTextEN: The one-eyed person took the lazy person home.
There were many people in their home,
there were adults and children,
they all had only one eye.

fullTextZH: 他们看到懒惰的人都说，哇！
fullTextEN: When they saw the lazy person, they all said, wow!
How strange!
He has two eyes!
At this time,
The one-eyed man caught the lazy person,
He said,

fullTextZH: 我们让大家来看这个有两只眼睛的人，
fullTextEN: We let everyone come to see this person with two eyes,
Charge 100 bucks per view.

fullTextZH: 这样我们可以赚很多钱喽！
fullTextEN: This way we can make a lot of money!

fullTextZH: 所以最后懒惰的人就住在笼子里，
fullTextEN: So in the end, the lazy person lived in a cage,

fullTextZH: 每天都有很多独眼人来看他。
fullTextEN: Every day, many one-eyed people came to see him.

fullTextZH: 这就是懒惰的人的故事。
fullTextEN: This is the story of the lazy person.
Do you think he is pitiful?
Or not pitiful?
Because it's his own fault.

fullTextZH: 我觉得每个人有时候都会懒惰，
fullTextEN: I think everyone is lazy sometimes,
When lazy,

fullTextZH: 可以想出奇怪但是不错的方法。
fullTextEN: You can come up with strange but good ideas.
But if lazy every day,
Always being lazy is not okay.

fullTextZH: 我希望你喜欢今天的故事。
fullTextEN: I hope you liked today's story.

fullTextZH: 那我们下次再见吧，拜拜！
fullTextEN: Then we'll see you next time, bye-bye!
